seo.title: About Luke, Founder of Learn Try Earn | LTE
seo.description: Meet Luke, an independent trader for nearly 10 years. See how Learn Try Earn approaches gold, silver, Bitcoin and Ethereum with a plan and risk first.

top.h11: Meet Luke, the trader behind Learn Try *Earn.*
top.p1: I’m Luke, the founder of Learn Try Earn, and I’ve been trading independently for nearly 10 years. I created this platform to share my experience, explain the markets I trade and help others build a clearer understanding of trading.

story.h21: From the trading floor to trading *independently.*
story.p1: How nearly 10 years of independent trading began, and why it shapes the way Learn Try Earn teaches.
story.h31: A seat on a London trading *floor.*
story.p2: My interest in financial markets originally led me to consider a career in investment banking in London, with the ambition of working on a trading floor. I was drawn to the analytical thinking, fast-moving environment and challenge of making decisions as markets responded to events around the world.
story.p3: As I considered the direction I wanted my life to take, I decided that trading independently was a better fit for me. It offered the freedom to develop my own approach and build my working life around my priorities, while taking responsibility for my own decisions.
story.p4: You have to establish your own structure, question your judgement and accept the consequences when an idea does not work out.
story.p5: Those principles shape the approach I want to share through Learn Try Earn: explaining the markets I trade and helping you build a clearer understanding of trading.

section3.p1: Trading on your own means nobody else sets the rules. These three come first.
section3.p2: Decide what you trade, what you’re looking for and how much you’re prepared to risk before the market gives you a reason to act.
section3.p3: Test every idea against the chart and the plan. Feeling confident is not a reason to enter a trade.
section3.p4: Some ideas won’t work out. Planning the downside first means a loss is an outcome you prepared for, not a surprise.

focus.p1: My main focus is precious metals, particularly gold and silver. These are the markets I spend most of my time following and trading, and they sit at the centre of this platform’s educational content.
focus.p2: Gold and silver are where most of my time, analysis and trading goes, and where most of what you’ll learn here is centred.
focus.p3: Alongside precious metals, I also trade cryptocurrency occasionally. These form a smaller part of my trading activity.

approach.p1: The aim is to help you understand how to approach these markets with a plan, before any money is at risk.
approach.p2: The structure, levels and conditions that make gold and silver worth watching on a given day.
approach.p3: Weigh a potential setup against your plan, the wider context and how clearly the chart supports it.
approach.p4: Decide where you’re wrong and how much you’re prepared to lose before you open a position.

goal.h21: The goal of Learn Try Earn
goal.p1: A practical understanding of financial markets, with gold and silver at the centre and Bitcoin and Ethereum alongside. *Built on a process you understand.*
goal.p2: Whether you are starting from scratch or looking to bring more structure to your approach, the aim is to help you develop stronger foundations.
goal.p3: Know what moves gold, silver and crypto, and when each is most active.
goal.p4: Decide what you’re looking for before the session starts.
goal.p5: Define the downside first and size every position from it.
goal.p6: Look back at every decision, including the ones that didn’t work.

section7.p1: Nearly 10 years of independent trading provides the background to this platform, but experience does not remove uncertainty. **Losses are part of trading, and no strategy or educational service can guarantee profitability.**
section7.p2: What I want to offer is a clear, grounded learning environment where the emphasis is on knowledge, personal responsibility and developing a process you understand.

section8.p1: Join the Telegram for entries and analysis, and watch the full process live on TikTok.
section8.p2: Educational content, not financial advice. Trading involves significant risk.
